one_line_idea: Face enhancement shifts identity-verification scores asymmetrically across demographic groups, so restoration can silently change biometric outcomes with disparate impact.
core_hypothesis: [HYPOTHESIS] Restoration-induced changes to identity-embedding similarity are not demographically uniform: groups underrepresented in restoration training data experience larger and more variable similarity shifts, measurably changing false-match and false-non-match behavior after enhancement.

judge_c.anomaly_note: Face enhancement shifts identity-verification scores asymmetrically across demographic groups — fairness-relevant disparate-impact mechanism; protect.

one_line_idea: Most claimed architecture gains in SR are training-recipe gains: under matched modern recipes, a decade of architectural innovations compresses into a much smaller quality spread than the literature implies.
core_hypothesis: [HYPOTHESIS] Retraining historical SR architectures under one modern shared recipe will compress inter-architecture differences dramatically, showing that much of the reported progression reflects recipe evolution rather than architectural superiority.

one_line_idea: SR models are not scale-consistent (twice 2x differs from once 4x), and enforcing scale-composition consistency at training improves generalization to unseen scales for free.
core_hypothesis: [HYPOTHESIS] The divergence between composed and direct upscaling is large and systematic (composition amplifies each stage's biases), and adding a composition-consistency loss both shrinks the divergence and improves quality at scales never seen in training.

one_line_idea: Small-crop training biases SR models against global structure: long edges, vanishing lines, and large-scale gradients are reconstructed with systematic errors that large-context training fixes.
core_hypothesis: [HYPOTHESIS] Crop-bounded training leaves models unable to maintain global geometric coherence (straightness of long edges, perspective-consistent texture gradients, smooth large-area shading), producing measurable structure errors on full images that crop-based metrics never see, and training with larger context repairs them at modest cost.

one_line_idea: SR models get amplitude spectra roughly right but phase systematically wrong, and phase error is the better predictor of perceived structural artifacts, motivating phase-aware losses.
core_hypothesis: [HYPOTHESIS] Trained SR models allocate error disproportionately to phase in high frequencies (plausible energy, misplaced structure), phase error correlates with human-perceived structural artifacts better than amplitude error, and adding an explicit phase-coherence term to training reduces structural artifacts at equal amplitude accuracy.

judge_c.anomaly_note: SR gets amplitude spectra right but phase systematically wrong, and phase error predicts perceived structural artifacts — crisp, subject-native, non-template.

one_line_idea: Restoration data scaling hits diminishing returns quickly on content diversity but not on degradation diversity, so data budgets should buy degradations, not images.
core_hypothesis: [HYPOTHESIS] Restoration quality saturates rapidly with content count at fixed degradation coverage, while it keeps improving with degradation-distribution enrichment at fixed content, because the learned inverse operator depends more on degradation coverage than on content memorization.

one_line_idea: Blind training over mixed severities teaches models a severity-averaged inverse that is wrong for every severity, and cheap explicit severity conditioning dominates blind averaging.
core_hypothesis: [HYPOTHESIS] Networks trained blind over mixed severities partially average incompatible inverse operators rather than cleanly inferring severity per input, so an identical network given a coarse severity signal (even a noisy estimate) outperforms the blind version across the entire severity range at matched capacity.

one_line_idea: Iterative refinement helps sampling, not restoration: at matched compute, single-pass fidelity models match multi-step ones, and iteration only pays when the goal is drawing from a distribution.
core_hypothesis: [HYPOTHESIS] For evidence-bounded fidelity objectives, iteration adds nothing fundamental: a single-pass model with the iteration compute folded into its capacity matches multi-step fidelity, and iteration's real value is exclusively in distributional sampling for perceptual texture.

one_line_idea: Test-time geometric self-ensembling gains expose a fixable equivariance defect: equivariance-regularized training recovers the ensemble's benefit in a single pass.
core_hypothesis: [HYPOTHESIS] The self-ensemble gain measures the model's violation of geometric equivariance, and adding an equivariance-consistency loss during training removes most of the violation, delivering self-ensemble-level quality in one forward pass and eliminating the standard justification for eightfold inference.

one_line_idea: The semantically strongest layer/timestep for diffusion-feature extraction is set by signal-to-noise ratio, not raw timestep index, and therefore transfers across models and noise schedules once re-parameterized in SNR.
core_hypothesis: [HYPOTHESIS] Probe accuracy as a function of noise level collapses onto a single curve across models and schedules when indexed by log-SNR, because the denoising task difficulty (and hence the abstraction level of features) is determined by SNR alone.

one_line_idea: Dense correspondence ability in diffusion features lives in self-attention key/query geometry, not in convolutional value pathways, and the two can be dissociated by targeted feature surgery.
core_hypothesis: [HYPOTHESIS] Correspondence accuracy is carried by the key/query token geometry of self-attention layers, while value/conv pathways mainly carry appearance; matching on key/query subspaces alone preserves correspondence while matching on value subspaces alone collapses it.

one_line_idea: v-prediction and x0-prediction models yield markedly better high-noise semantic features than epsilon-prediction models of matched quality, because their outputs remain image-like where epsilon targets are nearly pure noise.
core_hypothesis: [HYPOTHESIS] At low SNR the learning signal for epsilon-parameterized networks is dominated by noise regression, so their internal features degrade faster with noise level than v- or x0-parameterized networks trained on the same data.

judge_c.anomaly_note: Prediction-parameterization (v/x0 vs epsilon) as the controller of high-noise feature quality — a concrete, checkable design-choice law.

one_line_idea: Diffusion features encode intrinsic scene properties (albedo, shading, material gloss) more linearly than contrastive or masked-image features, because generation requires photometric competence that discriminative objectives can discard.
core_hypothesis: [HYPOTHESIS] Generative pretraining preserves photometric factors as linearly decodable structure, whereas invariance-based objectives explicitly or implicitly suppress them, producing a measurable objective-dependent gap on intrinsics probes.

one_line_idea: Depth structure readable from image-diffusion features reflects genuinely 3D-consistent knowledge rather than 2D shading heuristics, testable by randomizing photometric cues and checking cross-view probe consistency.
core_hypothesis: [HYPOTHESIS] A nontrivial fraction of depth information in diffusion features survives photometric-cue randomization and remains consistent across viewpoints of the same scene, indicating internal 3D structure beyond monocular heuristics.

one_line_idea: Conditional denoisers queried with a null prompt produce semantically richer features than genuinely unconditional models of matched scale, because text conditioning during training organizes the internal representation even when unused at inference.
core_hypothesis: [HYPOTHESIS] Training-time text conditioning acts as an auxiliary supervision signal that structures intermediate features; a truly unconditional model trained on the same images will show systematically weaker semantic probes than the null-prompted conditional model.

judge_c.anomaly_note: Null-prompted conditional models beat genuinely unconditional ones: text conditioning organizes representations even when unused — surprising if true.

one_line_idea: Multi-timestep diffusion feature ensembles are mostly redundant: the timestep-feature stack has low effective rank, and a single well-chosen timestep plus a linear map recovers nearly all probe performance.
core_hypothesis: [HYPOTHESIS] Across timesteps, features are approximately linear transforms of a shared low-dimensional semantic core, so multi-timestep aggregation adds little beyond noise averaging.

one_line_idea: Diffusion transformers develop high-norm 'register-like' tokens analogous to those in supervised ViTs, and these tokens store global photometric/style state whose deletion selectively breaks style while sparing layout.
core_hypothesis: [HYPOTHESIS] Generative training also induces high-norm aggregate tokens, but their content differs: they buffer global appearance statistics (palette, illumination, style) needed for globally coherent synthesis, rather than classification-relevant summaries.

flags: wave1_adjacent:W13-P1-A-039 (register/outlier-token pathology family; DiT + photometric-state storage is a subject-native mechanism claim)

one_line_idea: Perception heads trained on one diffusion backbone transfer to a different diffusion backbone through a single linear adapter, indicating a shared 'generative representation geometry' across independently trained models.
core_hypothesis: [HYPOTHESIS] Diffusion models trained on similar data converge to representations that are equivalent up to a linear map, so frozen heads plus a cheap adapter recover most cross-model transfer performance.

one_line_idea: Generative pretraining specifically resolves symmetric-part ambiguity in semantic correspondence (left/right paws, wheels), predicting a large margin over discriminative features exactly on symmetry-confusable pairs and near-parity elsewhere.
core_hypothesis: [HYPOTHESIS] Because generation requires globally consistent part assignment (a left wheel must stay left across the image), diffusion features carry global side/orientation context that discriminative local features lack; the advantage concentrates on symmetry-confusable keypoints.

one_line_idea: Generative depth estimators fine-tuned from image diffusion models inherit a photometric prior that fails predictably on non-photorealistic inputs, locating the boundary of the 'repurpose a generator' recipe.
core_hypothesis: [HYPOTHESIS] The recipe's advantage is a photometric-realism prior; on inputs violating natural image statistics (line drawings, scientific visualizations, flat-shaded renders) generative depth models will degrade more than discriminatively pretrained depth models of matched in-domain accuracy.

one_line_idea: Image generators know occluded shape: diffusion features support amodal (completed-shape) segmentation probes far above discriminative features, because generation requires representing whole objects before occlusion.
core_hypothesis: [HYPOTHESIS] To synthesize plausible occlusion scenes, generative models internally represent complete object shape; linear probes on diffusion features will predict occluded object extent substantially better than probes on discriminative features with identical heads and data.

one_line_idea: Diffusion-classifier accuracy is bottlenecked by noise-sample variance rather than model knowledge, so paired-noise variance reduction closes most of the gap to discriminative readouts at a fraction of the usual inference cost.
core_hypothesis: [HYPOTHESIS] The class-conditional loss differences that drive the decision are small relative to per-noise-sample variance; sharing identical noise draws across classes and antithetic sampling shrink the estimator variance enough to reveal substantially higher underlying accuracy.

one_line_idea: Cross-attention localization in text-to-image models collapses selectively for relational prompts: attention maps localize single objects well but misassign attributes in two-object scenes at a rate predictable from token co-occurrence statistics.
core_hypothesis: [HYPOTHESIS] Attention-map localization is reliable exactly when prompt tokens map to visually distinctive regions independently, and breaks when attribute binding is required, with error rate rising with training-corpus co-occurrence between the attributes and both objects.

one_line_idea: Occlusion ordering (which object is in front) is linearly decodable from diffusion self-attention geometry without any depth supervision, and more accurately than from discriminative features.
core_hypothesis: [HYPOTHESIS] Synthesizing correct occlusions forces generators to represent depth ordering as an explicit relational feature, making pairwise front/behind relations linearly separable in attention-derived embeddings.

one_line_idea: Diffusion features degrade more gracefully under common corruptions than discriminative features, with a measurable crossover severity beyond which the denoising-adjacent pretraining advantage dominates.
core_hypothesis: [HYPOTHESIS] Because denoising training continuously exposes the network to corrupted inputs, diffusion features retain task-relevant structure deeper into corruption severity, producing a severity-dependent crossover where they overtake stronger clean-condition discriminative features.

flags: wave1_adjacent:W13-P1-C-028 (corruption benchmarks; J-016 is a mechanism claim about generative pretraining, not an eval critique)

one_line_idea: Structured inpainting is a scene-understanding test: masking context-critical regions and scoring semantic plausibility of completions yields a graded measure of what a generator understands about scenes, orthogonal to image-quality scores.
core_hypothesis: [HYPOTHESIS] Completion plausibility under context-selective masking (mask the road but keep the cars; mask the shadow but keep the object) measures relational scene knowledge, and models of similar image quality will separate widely on it.

one_line_idea: Single-image diffusion features carry motion affordances: a linear probe predicts the plausible optical-flow direction field of a static frame, revealing implicit dynamics knowledge in image-only generators.
core_hypothesis: [HYPOTHESIS] Natural images betray their dynamics (poses mid-stride, water direction, traffic orientation), and generative training encodes these cues into features from which coarse expected-motion fields are linearly decodable.

one_line_idea: A one-step distilled diffusion model retains most of the parent's dense-perception feature quality at 1/20th the extraction cost, making diffusion backbones cost-competitive with discriminative ViTs for the first time.
core_hypothesis: [HYPOTHESIS] Distillation to one step preserves the internal representation (which the student must keep to imitate the teacher's output map) even while trajectory information is lost, so probe performance drops far less than generation-diversity metrics do.

one_line_idea: Classifier-free guidance sharpens the output distribution with a lawful, measurable exponent: embedding-space sample variance shrinks as a power law in guidance scale, with mode-dropping onset at a critical scale predictable from conditional/unconditional score divergence.
core_hypothesis: [HYPOTHESIS] Guidance acts as a temperature-like sharpening whose variance-reduction exponent is approximately constant across prompts within a model, and modes drop when the sharpened density's local mass falls below a threshold set by the divergence between conditional and unconditional scores.

one_line_idea: CFG's benefit is confined to a narrow mid-trajectory SNR window, and its artifacts (oversaturation, waxy textures) are produced almost entirely by applying guidance outside that window at low noise.
core_hypothesis: [HYPOTHESIS] Semantic alignment is decided in a mid-SNR window where conditional and unconditional scores disagree about content; at low noise the disagreement is dominated by color/contrast statistics, so late guidance mostly extrapolates off-manifold and produces the saturation artifact family.

one_line_idea: The null-prompt baseline in CFG is the wrong anchor: replacing the empty-string unconditional branch with a learned corpus-mean prompt embedding yields equal alignment at lower guidance scales with fewer artifacts.
core_hypothesis: [HYPOTHESIS] The empty prompt is itself an off-distribution condition whose score has idiosyncratic biases; anchoring guidance at the corpus-mean condition produces a cleaner contrast direction, achieving the same alignment with smaller extrapolation magnitude.

one_line_idea: Negative prompts and positive guidance are mechanistically asymmetric: negation via score subtraction removes appearance features but cannot remove relational or compositional content, predicting a measurable class of un-negatable concepts.
core_hypothesis: [HYPOTHESIS] Score-space subtraction can suppress concepts encoded as roughly linear appearance directions (styles, textures, single objects) but fails for content encoded relationally (spatial arrangements, object counts, interactions), which lacks a subtractable direction.

judge_c.anomaly_note: Un-negatable concepts: score-subtraction negation removes appearance but cannot remove relational content — a predicted CLASS of failures, not an instance.

one_line_idea: Guidance direction transfers across model scale: the conditional-minus-unconditional score direction computed by a small cheap model can steer a large model's sampling with most of the alignment benefit at a fraction of the compute.
core_hypothesis: [HYPOTHESIS] The guidance direction is a low-complexity semantic signal that small models estimate nearly as well as large ones, so cross-model guidance (large conditional branch, small model providing the contrast) preserves alignment while cutting the second-branch cost.

one_line_idea: High guidance scales amplify verbatim training-set recall: for duplication-prone prompts, extraction rates rise superlinearly with guidance scale because guidance sharpens toward memorized attractors.
core_hypothesis: [HYPOTHESIS] Memorized images act as sharp modes of the conditional density; since guidance exponentially reweights toward regions where conditional and unconditional scores disagree most, it preferentially amplifies exactly those attractors.

one_line_idea: Per-prompt optimal guidance scale is predictable from prompt statistics alone (token rarity, length, specificity), enabling a trained scale-predictor that beats any fixed global scale on the alignment-diversity Pareto front.
core_hypothesis: [HYPOTHESIS] The optimal scale reflects how far the conditional distribution is from the marginal, which is estimable from prompt features (rarity, syntactic specificity, embedding norm), so a lightweight regressor can set scale per prompt.

one_line_idea: Cross-model CFG (conditional branch from model A, unconditional from model B) works if and only if the two models' score fields agree up to an affine map, giving an operational compatibility test for mixing generative models.
core_hypothesis: [HYPOTHESIS] The CFG contrast is meaningful only when both branches share a score geometry; a cheap pre-test measuring affine alignment of the two models' scores on common inputs predicts whether mixed guidance produces coherent images or artifact soup.

one_line_idea: Perceptual guidance strength is what saturates, not information: past a modest scale, extra guidance stops adding text-relevant image content and only shifts global statistics, measurable as a plateau in mutual-information proxies between prompt tokens and image regions.
core_hypothesis: [HYPOTHESIS] Token-to-region information transfer saturates at moderate guidance; beyond that point alignment-metric gains are driven by saturation/contrast statistics those metrics happen to reward, not by additional semantic binding.

one_line_idea: DDIM inversion error is spectrally lawful: reconstruction error concentrates where local high-frequency energy is high, so a cheap spectral map of an image predicts where subsequent edits will fail before any editing is attempted.
core_hypothesis: [HYPOTHESIS] Inversion error is dominated by the ODE discretization interacting with high-curvature score regions, which co-locate with high local spectral energy; therefore a per-region spectral statistic predicts per-region inversion and editing error.

one_line_idea: Inversion failure under classifier-free guidance is a per-timestep bias, not noise: the error grows systematically with guidance scale, and null-text-style fixes work precisely because they absorb this bias term, which can be measured and corrected directly.
core_hypothesis: [HYPOTHESIS] The guided reverse trajectory deviates from the inverted trajectory by a structured per-timestep offset dominated by the guidance term; this offset is low-dimensional and predictable, so a closed-form or cheaply fitted correction recovers most of what per-image optimization does.

one_line_idea: Iterated invert-edit cycles converge to model-typical attractor images: identity drifts toward the generator's mean style at a measurable geometric rate, giving a quantitative 'regression to the generative mean' law for sequential editing.
core_hypothesis: [HYPOTHESIS] Each invert-edit round trip contracts the image toward high-density regions of the model distribution; identity distance to the original grows with round count following a contraction-mapping pattern with a model-specific rate.

one_line_idea: The inversion-error gap between model-generated and real photographs of matched content is a quantitative measure of the generator's manifold mismatch, usable as a model-diagnostic that tracks training data coverage.
core_hypothesis: [HYPOTHESIS] The real-vs-generated inversion-error gap, computed over content-matched pairs, measures how far the model's learned manifold sits from the real data manifold in each content category, and it varies lawfully across categories with training-data density.

one_line_idea: No attention-based 'local' editor is actually local: every mainstream inversion-editing method leaks measurable background change, with a floor that current architectures cannot cross, quantified by a background-drift budget protocol.
core_hypothesis: [HYPOTHESIS] Because inversion is imperfect and attention manipulations perturb the whole computation graph, background drift has a nonzero floor across all current inversion-based editors, and the floor is set by inversion error rather than the editing mechanism.

one_line_idea: Invertibility collapses discontinuously as sampling steps shrink: below a critical step count the inversion round-trip error jumps rather than degrades smoothly, defining a phase boundary for edit-capable fast sampling.
core_hypothesis: [HYPOTHESIS] Inversion error is governed by ODE discretization stability, which has a step-size threshold behavior in high-curvature score regions; below a critical number of steps the round-trip loses content discontinuously rather than gracefully.

one_line_idea: Stochastic strength in SDEdit-style editing has a universal sweet spot in SNR terms: the structure-preservation versus realism crossover happens at a similar effective noise level across domains and models, collapsing a per-use hyperparameter to a constant.
core_hypothesis: [HYPOTHESIS] The crossover reflects where content-defining information lives in the corruption hierarchy, which is a property of natural-image statistics rather than the model or domain; in SNR units the optimal strength is approximately universal.

one_line_idea: Inverted latents carry a prompt fingerprint: inverting an image under the wrong caption embeds recoverable traces of that caption, biasing all downstream edits in measurable, caption-specific directions.
core_hypothesis: [HYPOTHESIS] Because guided inversion bends the trajectory using the caption's score contributions, the resulting latent is caption-contaminated: regenerating under a neutral prompt drifts toward the inversion caption's semantics at a measurable rate.

judge_c.anomaly_note: Inverted latents carry a recoverable fingerprint of the caption used at inversion — forensic and bias implications; non-template.

one_line_idea: Round-trip consistency (apply an edit, then apply its inverse instruction) is a label-free capability measure for instruction editors, and current editors will fail it at rates that single-edit benchmarks completely hide.
core_hypothesis: [HYPOTHESIS] Editing competence implies approximate invertibility for invertible instructions (add/remove, brighten/darken); measuring identity recovery after instruction round-trips exposes failure structure invisible to one-shot metrics and separates models that one-shot metrics rank as equal.

one_line_idea: Verbatim memorization versus duplication count follows a sharp sigmoidal threshold, and the threshold location shifts predictably with model capacity, yielding a quantitative memorization law usable for dataset dedup policy.
core_hypothesis: [HYPOTHESIS] Memorization probability versus log duplication count is sigmoidal with a capacity-dependent midpoint: doubling model parameters shifts the midpoint toward fewer required duplicates by a measurable, roughly constant factor.

one_line_idea: Text keys, not image copies, gate verbatim recall in text-to-image models: perturbing the prompt away from the memorized caption collapses extraction rates even for heavily duplicated images, enabling inference-time mitigation without retraining.
core_hypothesis: [HYPOTHESIS] Verbatim recall is retrieved through the conditioning pathway: memorized items are stored as caption-keyed attractors, so caption-space perturbations (paraphrase, token dropout) break retrieval even though the image remains 'stored' in the weights.

one_line_idea: Memorized items sit in measurably sharper score-field attractors: reverse trajectories initialized in a neighborhood converge to memorized images faster and from a wider basin than to novel generations, giving a geometric signature of memorization.
core_hypothesis: [HYPOTHESIS] Memorization corresponds to local over-sharpening of the learned density: around memorized outputs, trajectory convergence rate is higher and sensitivity to initial-noise perturbation is lower than around matched novel outputs.

one_line_idea: Prompt-keyed memorization is stored in a localizable sliver of weights (dominantly cross-attention K/V): ablating under 1% of parameters removes specific memorized items with negligible global quality loss, enabling surgical unlearning.
core_hypothesis: [HYPOTHESIS] Caption-keyed recall is implemented as high-influence associations concentrated in cross-attention key/value projections for the trigger tokens, so gradient-attribution can locate and null the responsible weight sliver per item.

one_line_idea: Generators memorize compositions far more than pixels: layout-level templates from training data recur in generations at rates vastly exceeding verbatim copying, constituting a second, unmeasured tier of memorization.
core_hypothesis: [HYPOTHESIS] The denoiser stores compositional templates (object arrangement, pose, framing) with much lower storage cost than pixel content, so template recurrence survives dedup and appears at orders-of-magnitude higher rates than verbatim recall.

judge_c.anomaly_note: Layout-tier memorization: composition templates recur far above verbatim copying — a second, unmeasured tier of memorization; anchor of the memorization cell.

one_line_idea: Personalization fine-tuning (LoRA/DreamBooth-style) memorizes its few training images at rates orders of magnitude above pretraining memorization, with leakage growing superlinearly in fine-tuning steps, making 'private personalization' claims measurable and mostly false.
core_hypothesis: [HYPOTHESIS] With so few targets and many passes, personalization operates deep in the memorization regime: adapters store near-verbatim training images retrievable by prompt probing, with leakage increasing superlinearly in steps and inversely with subject-image count.

one_line_idea: Removing memorized attractors improves the model elsewhere: surgical unlearning of verbatim items increases sample diversity and prompt fidelity in the semantic neighborhood of the removed content, showing memorization actively harms nearby generalization.
core_hypothesis: [HYPOTHESIS] Sharp memorized modes capture probability mass and sampling trajectories from their semantic neighborhood, so nearby prompts under-explore; removing the attractor redistributes mass and measurably increases neighborhood diversity.

one_line_idea: Semantic layout is decided in a narrow early window of the reverse trajectory: swapping conditioning or noise mid-trajectory localizes a universal 'decision point' in SNR units beyond which content is frozen and only appearance changes.
core_hypothesis: [HYPOTHESIS] Content commitment is concentrated: there exists a narrow SNR band where swapping the prompt or re-drawing noise changes layout with high probability, collapsing to near-zero probability past the band, and the band location in SNR units is stable across models.

one_line_idea: A model's quality-versus-steps exponent predicts its distillability: generators whose sample quality converges fast in step count distill to few-step students with less loss, giving a cheap pre-test before paying distillation compute.
core_hypothesis: [HYPOTHESIS] Both step-count convergence and distillability are governed by the curvature of the model's probability-flow ODE: low-curvature models need fewer steps and are easier to compress into few-step students, so the convergence exponent is a proxy for distillation loss.

one_line_idea: Popular samplers do not sample the same distribution: at convergence-equivalent settings, different sampler families produce distributionally distinct outputs (hue, contrast, composition statistics), so sampler choice silently changes every downstream measurement.
core_hypothesis: [HYPOTHESIS] Discretization biases differ by sampler family and persist at practical step counts, producing measurable distribution-level differences (not just per-image noise) that exceed evaluation error bars.

one_line_idea: Score-field curvature concentrates in a narrow SNR band, and allocating steps adaptively to that band beats hand-tuned schedules at matched compute, turning schedule design into a measurable-quantity optimization.
core_hypothesis: [HYPOTHESIS] Local truncation error is dominated by trajectory curvature, which is empirically concentrated in a measurable SNR band; measuring curvature once per model and placing steps by curvature mass dominates generic schedules.

one_line_idea: The initial noise seed is a composition genome: under deterministic sampling, seeds impose transferable coarse layouts across prompts, and the seed-layout map is stable enough to build a searchable layout library with no model modification.
core_hypothesis: [HYPOTHESIS] With ODE sampling, initial noise determines coarse composition largely independently of the prompt, so layout similarity between same-seed different-prompt generations far exceeds different-seed baselines, enabling seed-indexed layout control.

judge_c.anomaly_note: Seed as composition genome with a searchable layout library — folklore turned into a falsifiable mapping (+ absorbed J-053 steering arm).

one_line_idea: Early-stopping the reverse ODE at a nonzero noise floor is an implicit truncation trick for diffusion: it trades diversity for typicality along a lawful curve, giving a free post-hoc knob equivalent to GAN truncation with a measurable exponent.
core_hypothesis: [HYPOTHESIS] Terminating sampling early (then doing a final x0-prediction) contracts outputs toward high-density regions, producing a diversity-typicality tradeoff curve with a stable exponent that complements guidance and composes with it predictably.

one_line_idea: Sample spread of generative depth models localizes at genuinely ill-posed pixels: multi-sample dispersion concentrates at occlusion boundaries and scale-ambiguous regions, matching multi-sensor disagreement rather than being uniform noise.
core_hypothesis: [HYPOTHESIS] Because the generative prior learns the multi-modality of the depth-given-image relationship, per-pixel sample dispersion is not isotropic noise but tracks the physically ill-posed structure: it peaks where the inverse problem genuinely admits multiple answers.

one_line_idea: Generative segmentation samplers reproduce the distribution of human annotator disagreement, not just its magnitude: sampled mask sets match inter-annotator mask distributions on multi-rater datasets better than any softmax-derived baseline.
core_hypothesis: [HYPOTHESIS] Diffusion mask samplers learn the joint structure of plausible annotations, so their sample sets capture correlated, region-level disagreement modes that per-pixel independence assumptions cannot express.

flags: banned_cluster_adjacent:annotation-disagreement subject used constructively (distribution-matching capability), NOT pathology-primary; do not count against the annotation ban, but watch the framing at consolidation

one_line_idea: Diffusion posterior samplers for inverse problems systematically under-disperse: sampled posteriors are provably narrower than the true posterior in controlled linear inverse settings, with a measurable contraction factor that practitioners should correct for.
core_hypothesis: [HYPOTHESIS] Approximations in posterior-guidance methods (likelihood linearization, score errors, mode-seeking dynamics) compound into systematic over-concentration: the sampled posterior's variance underestimates the true posterior variance by a large, quantifiable factor that grows with measurement sparsity.

judge_c.anomaly_note: Provable under-dispersion of diffusion posterior samplers in controlled linear inverse problems, with a correction factor — theory-grade and deployment-relevant.

one_line_idea: Distilling a generative dense predictor into a one-step model destroys ambiguity information in a predictable spatial pattern: the student blurs exactly where the teacher's samples disperse, converting represented multi-modality into averaged error.
core_hypothesis: [HYPOTHESIS] Distillation objectives implicitly average over teacher modes; at pixels where the teacher's posterior is multi-modal the student regresses to the mean, so student blur/error maps will spatially match teacher dispersion maps.

one_line_idea: The learned generative prior dominates conditioning evidence at a lawful, measurable noise threshold: for conditional dense prediction, prior-driven hallucination onsets where the condition's information rate falls below the prior's, predicting exactly where generative predictors invent content.
core_hypothesis: [HYPOTHESIS] Along the sampling trajectory there is a per-region crossover between evidence-dominated and prior-dominated dynamics, measurable by comparing output sensitivity to input perturbations against sensitivity to prior perturbations; hallucination localizes past the crossover.

one_line_idea: Consensus across diffusion samples predicts correctness in-domain but the coupling collapses under domain shift in a measurable way, defining the validity boundary for using sample agreement as a quality proxy.
core_hypothesis: [HYPOTHESIS] Agreement-accuracy coupling is a property of the training distribution: under distribution shift the model can be confidently wrong in correlated ways across samples, so consensus stays high while accuracy falls, breaking the proxy exactly when it is most needed.

one_line_idea: Attribute-binding failures are decided in a narrow early timestep window through cross-attention competition, so timestep-targeted attention intervention fixes most binding errors while leaving the rest of generation untouched.
core_hypothesis: [HYPOTHESIS] Binding is resolved when object regions first individuate (early, high-noise steps); attribute tokens compete for regions only in that window, so interventions confined to it capture the full fixable fraction of binding failures at minimal collateral cost.

one_line_idea: Object-count control fails because count is not linearly represented anywhere in the conditioning pathway beyond small numbers: probing text and image streams will find count decodable up to about four and absent beyond, matching the generation failure boundary.
core_hypothesis: [HYPOTHESIS] The failure is representational: the conditioning pathway encodes numerosity like a subitizing system (distinct up to ~4, log-compressed beyond), so generation cannot execute counts its representation does not distinguish; probe decodability and generation accuracy will share the same breakpoint.

one_line_idea: Prompt token influence follows a lawful positional decay: later tokens in long prompts lose per-token causal effect on the image at a measurable rate, and re-normalizing attention by position recovers late-token content without retraining.
core_hypothesis: [HYPOTHESIS] Softmax attention over many tokens dilutes per-token mass with prompt length and position (compounded by causal text-encoder biases), producing a measurable positional influence decay that a position-corrected attention rescaling can flatten.

one_line_idea: The same concept prompted in different languages generates measurably different visual distributions, and the differences are systematic (cultural-visual priors of the training pairs), quantifying language as a hidden conditioning variable in multilingual models.
core_hypothesis: [HYPOTHESIS] The conditioning pathway binds each language's tokens to that language's co-occurring visual statistics, so translation-equivalent prompts yield distribution-level differences (objects, settings, aesthetics) far exceeding sampling noise, predictable from corpus provenance.

judge_c.anomaly_note: Language as a hidden conditioning variable: same concept in different languages yields systematically different visual distributions — cultural-prior quantification.

one_line_idea: Spatial prepositions are executed by 2D canvas priors, not relational understanding: 'X above Y' succeeds only when the pair's canonical canvas arrangement agrees, and fails at predictable rates under counterfactual arrangements.
core_hypothesis: [HYPOTHESIS] The model resolves spatial prepositions by sampling the most frequent canvas arrangement of the object pair from training statistics; genuine relational control exists only weakly, so accuracy collapses when the requested relation contradicts the canonical arrangement.

one_line_idea: Conditioning modalities have a stable dominance hierarchy with measurable exchange rates: when text and structural conditions (edges, pose, depth) conflict, the resolution follows a lawful ordering that predicts multi-condition behavior before running it.
core_hypothesis: [HYPOTHESIS] Each conditioning channel exerts influence proportional to its information rate about pixels and its injection depth; conflicts resolve by a consistent dominance ordering (dense structural > sparse structural > text) with quantifiable exchange rates that are stable across content.

one_line_idea: Negation blindness lives in the text encoder, not the denoiser: negated prompts embed nearly identically to their affirmative forms, and embedding-level surgery fixes more negation failures than any sampling-time intervention.
core_hypothesis: [HYPOTHESIS] Contrastively trained text encoders map negated phrases close to affirmative ones (negation words carry little visual-embedding weight), so the denoiser never receives the negation; interventions that re-inject negation at the embedding level will dominate sampling-time fixes.

one_line_idea: Prompt rewriting by users converges on a folk grammar that works for lawful reasons: quantifying which rewrite operations (reordering, splitting, weighting) causally change generation shows most folk tricks are placebo while a small set has large, consistent effects.
core_hypothesis: [HYPOTHESIS] Only rewrite operations that change the embedding geometry meaningfully (content-word placement, splitting compound clauses) causally affect outputs, while popular decorations (quality tags, emphasis punctuation) have effects indistinguishable from resampling noise on modern models.

one_line_idea: Distillation eats the tails first: few-step students lose rare modes (uncommon classes, unusual compositions) long before average-quality metrics degrade, following a lawful tail-truncation order predictable from teacher mode mass.
core_hypothesis: [HYPOTHESIS] Distillation objectives weight learning by probability mass, so student coverage shrinks from the tails inward: mode-level recall falls in inverse order of teacher mode mass, with a measurable truncation frontier that advances as steps decrease.

one_line_idea: Few-step students lose input sensitivity, not just diversity: the Jacobian of output with respect to conditioning collapses under distillation, predicting that distilled models are disproportionately worse for editing and control than for prompted generation.
core_hypothesis: [HYPOTHESIS] Compressing an iterative refinement into few steps forces the student toward locally flat input-output maps (small condition-Jacobian), so fine-grained condition changes (prompt tweaks, control-signal deltas) produce weaker, coarser output changes than the teacher's.

one_line_idea: Distillation concentrates memorization: few-step students reproduce the teacher's memorized items at equal or higher rates while losing non-memorized diversity, so the privacy-risk fraction of outputs increases through the very process meant to cheapen deployment.
core_hypothesis: [HYPOTHESIS] Memorized items are sharp high-mass attractors that distillation objectives preserve preferentially, while diffuse novel modes are pruned; the student's output distribution therefore over-represents memorized content relative to the teacher.

one_line_idea: Guidance baked into distilled weights freezes the alignment-diversity operating point: no inference-time knob recovers the diversity a guidance-distilled student gave up, proving the tradeoff became structural rather than parametric.
core_hypothesis: [HYPOTHESIS] Post-distillation, the diversity-alignment tradeoff is embedded in the learned map itself: sampling-time interventions (temperature-like noise scaling, early stopping, seed dithering) will fail to recover more than a small fraction of the teacher's accessible diversity range at matched alignment.

one_line_idea: Distillation error concentrates in a measurable SNR band, so hybrid schedules that spend the few available steps non-uniformly (dense where teacher curvature is high) beat uniform few-step schedules at matched compute.
core_hypothesis: [HYPOTHESIS] The student's disagreement with its teacher is not uniform over noise levels but peaks where the teacher's trajectory curvature is high; allocating student steps by measured disagreement mass recovers a meaningful fraction of the distillation loss for free.

one_line_idea: Violation of the semigroup property (two 1-step jumps disagreeing with one 2-step jump) is an intrinsic inconsistency measure for few-step models that tracks their distillation quality without any reference images or teacher access.
core_hypothesis: [HYPOTHESIS] An ideal few-step model's jumps compose consistently (the flow-map semigroup property); real students violate it in proportion to how badly distillation compressed the trajectory, so composition error is a reference-free proxy of distillation loss.

one_line_idea: Teacher-student representational alignment early in distillation predicts final student quality: CKA at matched noise levels after a small fraction of training forecasts the outcome, enabling early stopping of doomed distillation runs.
core_hypothesis: [HYPOTHESIS] Successful distillation proceeds by first aligning internal representations and then refining outputs; early representational alignment (CKA between teacher and student features at matched SNR) is therefore a leading indicator of final output quality.

one_line_idea: One-step generators are qualitatively different objects from few-step ones: the 1-to-2 step transition shows a discontinuous jump in output-map smoothness and failure structure, while 2-to-8 steps vary smoothly, locating the real boundary of 'diffusion-like' behavior.
core_hypothesis: [HYPOTHESIS] With two or more steps the model retains an intermediate-correction mechanism (see noise, adjust) that a single-step map structurally lacks; measurable properties (input-Jacobian spectra, artifact taxonomy, OOD-prompt behavior) will show a discontinuity between 1 and 2 steps and smooth variation beyond.

judge_c.anomaly_note: One-step generators are qualitatively different objects: discontinuity at the 1-to-2 step transition locates the boundary of diffusion-like behavior.

one_line_idea: Latent compression sets a hard fidelity floor for small structures: objects below a critical pixel size cannot be faithfully generated by 8x-downsampling latent models regardless of denoiser scale, and the decode(encode(x)) roundtrip bound cleanly attributes such failures to the VAE, not the denoiser.
core_hypothesis: [HYPOTHESIS] The VAE roundtrip decode(encode(x)) is an upper bound on achievable fidelity per structure size; measured roundtrip fidelity will show a critical size below which information is destroyed, and generation failures on small structures will track this bound rather than denoiser capacity.

one_line_idea: Latent space is perceptually non-uniform: equal latent distances correspond to wildly different perceptual changes across image regions and content types, distorting every latent-space loss, edit magnitude, and interpolation built on it.
core_hypothesis: [HYPOTHESIS] The VAE's compression objective allocates latent resolution by reconstruction difficulty, not perceptual salience, so the local latent-to-perceptual metric ratio varies by an order of magnitude across content (faces versus sky), making latent distances systematically misleading.

one_line_idea: VAE decoders hallucinate texture deterministically: the fake high-frequency detail added during decoding is a repeatable function of latent content (not random), meaning latent generators systematically sign their outputs with decoder-specific texture and cannot represent certain true textures at all.
core_hypothesis: [HYPOTHESIS] Decoder texture synthesis is deterministic given the latent: repeated decodes and near-duplicate latents produce near-identical fake texture, implying a fixed texture vocabulary that (a) fingerprints the decoder and (b) excludes textures outside its vocabulary from ever being generated faithfully.

judge_c.anomaly_note: VAE decoders hallucinate texture deterministically — decoder-signature textures and unrepresentable true textures; underpins forensic and eval claims.

one_line_idea: Latent channels carry stable global roles (luma-like, chroma-like, detail-like) consistent across images, so channel-targeted interventions provide training-free global controls (exposure, palette, detail level) with predictable effects.
core_hypothesis: [HYPOTHESIS] Compression pressure plus image statistics push VAEs toward a decorrelated color-like basis: individual channels (or fixed linear combinations) will have consistent global functions across content, making channel arithmetic a reliable control surface.

one_line_idea: Dense prediction from latent-diffusion features inherits a measurable VAE ceiling: label information destroyed by encode-decode roundtrips bounds what any latent-space feature can support, explaining boundary-precision gaps versus pixel-space backbones.
core_hypothesis: [HYPOTHESIS] Whatever task information the VAE roundtrip destroys (thin-structure identity, precise boundary location) is unavailable to latent features in principle; the roundtrip label-consistency bound will predict the task-performance ceiling of latent-feature probes, especially at boundaries.

one_line_idea: Sampled latents sometimes leave the decoder-valid region, producing a distinct artifact family; a cheap latent-typicality projection at the final step removes these artifacts without retraining anything.
core_hypothesis: [HYPOTHESIS] The denoiser can terminate at latents outside the encoder's output distribution (where the decoder was never trained); artifact occurrences will coincide with measurable latent atypicality, and projecting final latents toward the encoder-output manifold will remove the artifact family with minimal content change.

one_line_idea: The shared-VAE ecosystem correlates errors across 'independent' models: generators built on the same public autoencoder share failure modes and texture signatures, so ensembling them recovers far less than ensemble theory predicts.
core_hypothesis: [HYPOTHESIS] The shared decoder imposes shared blind spots (texture vocabulary, small-structure floor, color quirks); error correlation between same-VAE model pairs will substantially exceed correlation between different-VAE pairs, and same-VAE ensembles will underperform predicted ensemble gains.

judge_c.anomaly_note: Shared-VAE ecosystem correlates errors across 'independent' models, deflating ensemble gains — supply-chain claim mirroring accepted F-060's spirit at the architecture level.

one_line_idea: Decoder swapping is a causal attribution instrument: decoding one model's latents with another compatible decoder cleanly splits every output property (artifact, texture, color bias) into denoiser-caused versus decoder-caused, with percentage attributions.
core_hypothesis: [HYPOTHESIS] For VAEs trained on similar data with compatible latent conventions, cross-decoding is faithful enough that property changes under decoder swap measure the decoder's causal share of each output property, yielding a reusable attribution protocol.

one_line_idea: Coarse-to-fine generation is an artifact of Gaussian noise schedules, not an intrinsic property of diffusion: alternative corruption operators reorder which image structure is decided when, causing predictable trades between layout errors and texture errors.
core_hypothesis: [HYPOTHESIS] The generation order of spatial frequencies is fully determined by the corruption operator's frequency-versus-time SNR profile; corruptions that destroy low frequencies first will produce fine-to-coarse generation and correspondingly shifted error profiles (more layout errors, fewer texture errors).

judge_c.anomaly_note: Coarse-to-fine generation is a property of Gaussian schedules, not diffusion itself — corruption-operator counterfactual with representation-learning consequences.

one_line_idea: Diffusion models under-generate high-frequency power with a lawful spectral deficit: the gap between generated and real power spectra has a stable shape per model family, predicting which fine-structure content will systematically look 'smoothed'.
core_hypothesis: [HYPOTHESIS] Training dynamics and finite sampling systematically under-fit the highest frequency octaves; the relative spectral deficit curve (generated over real power versus frequency) is stable across content categories within a model and shifts predictably with sampling steps and model scale.

one_line_idea: Per-SNR validation loss exposes under-trained noise bands left by the training-time timestep-sampling distribution, and cheap targeted fine-tuning on those bands yields outsized quality gains compared to uniform continued training.
core_hypothesis: [HYPOTHESIS] The timestep distribution leaves fingerprints: noise bands undersampled during training will show elevated per-SNR validation loss, and reallocating a small fine-tuning budget to those bands will improve generation quality more than the same budget spent uniformly.

one_line_idea: Optimal noise schedules are derivable from data power spectra: matching the schedule to the domain's spectral statistics (natural 1/f versus other spectra in specialized domains) beats natural-image-default schedules by a predictable margin in non-natural domains.
core_hypothesis: [HYPOTHESIS] The schedule's job is to spread information destruction evenly over time; given a domain's power spectrum this schedule is computable in closed form, and the mismatch between default and spectrum-derived schedules predicts the achievable improvement per domain.

one_line_idea: The corruption operator determines representation content: models trained with blur-based versus noise-based corruption learn measurably different feature families (shape-biased versus texture-complete), making corruption choice a representation-learning design axis.
core_hypothesis: [HYPOTHESIS] Restoring from different corruptions requires different information: blur-corruption training (which preserves layout, destroys detail) will induce features stronger on shape/layout probes, while noise-corruption training induces more complete texture/appearance features, with consistent probe-profile differences at matched generation quality.

one_line_idea: Remaining uncertainty during sampling is frequency-ordered, enabling a 'spectral progress bar': partial trajectories reveal exactly which frequency bands are already decided, supporting early quality prediction and band-selective compute allocation.
core_hypothesis: [HYPOTHESIS] At any trajectory point, low-frequency content is locked while high-frequency content remains undecided, with the moving boundary computable from the schedule; intermediate x0-predictions therefore contain final low-band content exactly, making band-resolved early readouts faithful.

one_line_idea: Video diffusion buys temporal smoothness by suppressing motion diversity: generated videos systematically under-disperse motion statistics relative to real footage, a lawful bias measurable with optical-flow distributions and traceable to temporal-consistency objectives.
core_hypothesis: [HYPOTHESIS] Temporal-attention and consistency losses penalize exactly the high-variance motion that real scenes contain, so generated flow-magnitude and flow-direction distributions will be compressed (lower variance, thinner tails) relative to content-matched real video by a stable factor.

judge_c.anomaly_note: Video diffusion buys smoothness by suppressing motion diversity — lawful under-dispersion of motion statistics; measurable and consequential.

one_line_idea: Structured continuation probes measure intuitive physics in video generators as a graded capability profile: object permanence, gravity consistency, and collision plausibility form a reproducible difficulty hierarchy that model scale climbs in a fixed order.
core_hypothesis: [HYPOTHESIS] Physical regularities differ in the temporal range and relational complexity needed to enforce them, producing a stable difficulty ordering (permanence easiest, multi-object dynamics hardest); models will pass them in a consistent order as capability grows rather than uniformly improving.

one_line_idea: Video generation commits appearance and layout within the first few frames and then propagates: a temporal commitment horizon exists after which conditioning changes can no longer alter scene identity, only motion, measurable by mid-generation condition swaps.
core_hypothesis: [HYPOTHESIS] Video diffusion resolves scene identity (appearance, layout) using early-frame content as an anchor and afterwards operates in a propagation regime; condition swaps after the commitment horizon will change motion continuation but not scene identity, with a sharp measurable boundary.

one_line_idea: Video models are interpolators before they are extrapolators: quality degrades sharply and asymmetrically when generation must continue beyond observed context versus fill between anchors, quantifying how far current models are from forward world modeling.
core_hypothesis: [HYPOTHESIS] Training distributions and objectives reward consistency with surrounding context, so constrained-on-both-sides generation is fundamentally easier: at matched content, extrapolation quality will fall off with horizon length much faster than interpolation quality falls with gap length.

one_line_idea: Video-diffusion features provide time-consistent correspondence that survives occlusion without any tracking supervision: memory-like matching emerges from generative video training, beating per-frame image-feature chaining exactly on occlusion-heavy tracks.
core_hypothesis: [HYPOTHESIS] To generate coherent video through occlusion events, video diffusion models must internally maintain object identity across gaps; their features will therefore support track-through-occlusion matching that per-frame image features cannot, without any tracking-specific training.

one_line_idea: Long-horizon autoregressive video generation collapses into periodic attractors: continuation loops with a period set by the model's temporal receptive field, so measuring collapse periodicity reverse-engineers the effective temporal memory of black-box video models.
core_hypothesis: [HYPOTHESIS] Once genuinely novel content exhausts, the conditioning window sees near-repeated states and the model enters a limit cycle; the cycle period will track the effective temporal context length, making periodicity a behavioral measurement of memory span.

one_line_idea: Camera motion and object motion are entangled in current video models: no internal direction moves the camera while freezing the scene, and the degree of entanglement is measurable, defining a concrete deficit that 3D-aware conditioning must close.
core_hypothesis: [HYPOTHESIS] Because 2D pixel motion confounds the two sources, video models represent total motion holistically: attempted interventions (prompting, latent steering) that request pure camera motion will produce correlated object motion, with an entanglement index far above what explicit-camera-conditioned models achieve.

one_line_idea: Video models memorize clips at lower duplication thresholds than image models memorize images: temporal redundancy (many near-duplicate frames per clip) acts as built-in duplication, making video memorization lawfully easier and current image-derived privacy intuitions wrong for video.
core_hypothesis: [HYPOTHESIS] Each training clip effectively presents its content many times (across frames and overlapping windows), shifting the memorization dose-response left: video models will reproduce training clips at corpus-duplication levels far below the image-model threshold, with the shift predictable from within-clip redundancy statistics.

judge_c.anomaly_note: Video models memorize at LOWER duplication thresholds than image models because temporal redundancy is built-in duplication — privacy intuitions ported from images are wrong.
